''See also: [[gold light (The Traveler's Gate Trilogy) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Gold]] [[Light]] is a sentient and powerful force that exists within the mind of an individual. It possesses its own personality, capable of laughing, offering advice, and expressing approval or feelings that resemble dark humor and grim secrets. It acts as a source of comfort and strength, comparable to an unseen sun, while simultaneously challenging its host to be brave and confront the truth. In physical manifestations, the [[Gold]] [[Light]] is capable of immense destructive force, such as emitting blasts that can blind opponents, shatter objects, and cause fires. It has also been known to urge its host to change their methods of combat by no longer fighting like a [[Traveler]].}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The gold light is a [[madra]] residing within [[Alin]] that he can manifest to fill his hands with a shining glow. This entity functions as a sentient voice capable of asking [[Alin]] questions or raging at him, even crying out for victory within his heart. During combat, the light can be summoned to fill [[Alin]]'s palms with destructive power, shaped into a golden blade, or hurled as energetic blasts. The light has expressed frustration toward [[Alin]] for allowing enemies to escape, though he remains prepared to unleash its power.}}
